subject: Re: Kickoff: pruning toolkit — staffing + compute
body:
Hi Zofia,

Staffing: Hyun Traore 40% as tech lead across both pruning families; Wei Ivanov 40% on the pilot-team integrations; Giannis Sato 30% on the mask-stripping/deployment tooling; Jorge Vidal 20% on CI and the benchmark harness. Vera Egede is committed at 65% to this project for May 2026 — she owns the gradient-based pruning comparison and the final sparsity-vs-quality report, and that report is the deliverable the whole window closes on. In April she's at 30% while she wraps a language-team commitment.

Compute: the comparison grid (two models x two pruning methods x four sparsity targets) needs 96 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort through April and May. No Vulcan ask.

One constraint to note: block sparsity trades quality for actual hardware speedup, so the report will quote both raw sparsity and block-sparse throughput — otherwise the model teams will pick settings that look good and serve slow.

Ivo
